undiscovered.zh: 未被發現的；不為人知的
ai: The island remained undiscovered for hundreds of years.
這座島嶼數百年來一直未被人發現。
She was an undiscovered talent working in a small café.
她是一位在小咖啡館工作、尚未被發掘的人才。
Many species in the deep sea are still undiscovered.
深海中仍有許多物種尚未被發現。

haydn.zh: 海頓（奧地利古典樂派作曲家）
ai: Haydn was an Austrian composer who wrote over a hundred symphonies.
海頓是奧地利作曲家，寫過一百多首交響曲。
We listened to a string quartet by Haydn at the concert.
我們在音樂會上聽了海頓的一首弦樂四重奏。

ramshackle.zh: 破舊搖晃的；快要倒塌的
ai: They lived in a ramshackle house at the edge of the village.
他們住在村莊邊緣一間破舊搖搖欲墜的房子裡。
The ramshackle fence leaned to one side after the storm.
暴風雨過後，那道破舊的籬笆向一邊傾斜。
He parked his ramshackle truck behind the barn.
他把那輛破爛的卡車停在穀倉後面。
He's a friendly feller who always says hello.
他是個友善的傢伙，總是會打招呼。
That old feller next door knows everyone in town.
隔壁那個老傢伙認識鎮上每個人。
The feller swung his axe and the tree began to lean.
伐木工人揮動斧頭，樹開始傾斜。
A skilled feller can bring down a tree in a chosen direction.
熟練的伐木工人能讓樹朝指定的方向倒下。
There was long-standing enmity between the two families.
這兩個家族之間存在著長期的敵意。
Their enmity faded after years of working together.
多年共事之後，他們之間的敵意逐漸消散。
He felt no enmity toward the people who had criticized him.
他對批評過他的人毫無敵意。
The coach wants maximal effort from every player.
教練要求每位球員都全力以赴。
This setting gives maximal brightness but drains the battery fast.
這個設定能提供最大亮度，但會很快耗電。
Plants need maximal sunlight to grow well in spring.
植物在春天需要最充足的陽光才能長得好。
Sofia is the capital city of Bulgaria.
索非亞是保加利亞的首都。
We took a train from Sofia to the mountains.
我們從索非亞搭火車前往山區。
We went canoeing on the lake last weekend.
上週末我們去湖上划獨木舟。
Canoeing is a great way to enjoy quiet rivers.
划獨木舟是享受寧靜河流的好方法。
She learned canoeing at a summer camp.
她在夏令營學會了划獨木舟。
This juice contains no artificial preservatives.
這款果汁不含人工防腐劑。
Salt has long been used as a natural preservative.
鹽長久以來一直被當作天然防腐劑。
The label lists a preservative to keep the bread fresh.
標籤上列出了一種讓麵包保鮮的防腐劑。
Vinegar has a preservative effect on vegetables.
醋對蔬菜有保存的作用。
The preservative power of sugar keeps jam from spoiling.
糖的保存作用能讓果醬不變質。

corinthian.zh: （古希臘）科林斯的；科林斯式的
ai: The temple was built with tall Corinthian columns.
這座神殿用高大的科林斯式柱子建成。
Corinthian capitals are decorated with carved leaves.
科林斯式柱頭飾有雕刻的葉子圖案。

pisa.zh: 比薩（義大利城市，以斜塔聞名）
ai: Pisa is a city in Italy famous for its leaning tower.
比薩是義大利的一座城市，以斜塔聞名。
Tourists in Pisa often take photos pretending to hold up the tower.
比薩的遊客常拍下假裝撐住斜塔的照片。
Honey is thicker and more viscous than water.
蜂蜜比水更濃稠、更黏。
The viscous oil moved slowly down the pipe.
黏稠的油緩緩流過管子。
Cold weather makes engine oil more viscous.
寒冷的天氣會讓引擎機油變得更黏稠。
The minister's speech was recorded in Hansard.
部長的演說被記錄在議事錄裡。
You can search Hansard to read what was said in Parliament.
你可以搜尋議事錄來閱讀國會裡說過的話。
The newspaper tried to vilify him with false stories.
那家報紙試圖用不實的報導詆毀他。
It is unfair to vilify people just because they disagree with you.
只因為別人與你意見不同就詆毀他們，是不公平的。
She was vilified online for a mistake she did not make.
她因為一個自己沒犯的錯誤而在網路上遭到詆毀。
Toulouse is a large city in southern France.
圖盧茲是法國南部的一座大城市。
Many aircraft are built in Toulouse.
許多飛機是在圖盧茲製造的。
We took a riverboat down the Mississippi.
我們搭乘河船沿密西西比河而下。
The old riverboat carried passengers between two towns.
這艘老河船在兩個城鎮之間載客。
A riverboat slowly passed under the bridge.
一艘河船緩緩從橋下駛過。
The jurist wrote a famous book on international law.
這位法學家寫了一本關於國際法的著名著作。
A respected jurist was invited to speak at the university.
一位受人敬重的法學家受邀到大學演講。
The study looked at the causes of youth criminality.
這項研究探討青少年犯罪的成因。
There was no evidence of criminality in the company's records.
公司的紀錄中沒有任何犯罪行為的證據。
A feeling of restlessness kept him awake all night.
一種坐立不安的感覺讓他整夜睡不著。
The children's restlessness grew as the long ride went on.
隨著車程變長，孩子們越來越坐不住。
She felt a restlessness she could not explain.
她感到一種說不上來的焦躁。
She reads a short devotional book every morning.
她每天早上讀一本簡短的靈修書。
The choir sang devotional songs during the service.
詩班在禮拜中唱了敬拜的歌曲。
The church held a congregational meeting after the service.
教會在禮拜後召開了會眾大會。
Congregational singing filled the hall.
全體會眾的歌聲響徹大廳。
He was a pathfinder in the field of space research.
他是太空研究領域的開拓者。
The pathfinder walked ahead to mark a safe route.
探路者走在前面標出一條安全的路線。

stripped.zh: 剝去；脫去（strip 的過去式）
ai: She stripped the old paint from the wooden chair.
她把木椅上的舊油漆刮掉。
The wind stripped the leaves from the trees overnight.
一夜之間風把樹葉吹落殆盡。
He stripped off his wet coat and hung it by the door.
他脫下濕外套掛在門邊。
The room had stripped floors and bare white walls.
這個房間地板已去漆，牆面是光禿的白色。
The stripped-down version of the app is faster.
這個精簡版的應用程式速度更快。
She faced her illness with great fortitude.
她以極大的堅毅面對自己的病痛。
It took fortitude to keep going after so many failures.
在這麼多次失敗之後還能繼續前進，需要堅忍的毅力。
The team showed fortitude in the face of difficulty.
團隊在面對困難時展現了堅韌的精神。
The priest gave a talk based on a scriptural passage.
神父根據一段聖經經文發表了談話。
They studied the scriptural teachings of their faith.
他們研讀自己信仰中的經典教導。
The actor sued the magazine for defamation.
這位演員控告那本雜誌誹謗。
Spreading false rumors can count as defamation.
散布不實謠言可能構成誹謗。
The vegetables were grown organically without chemical sprays.
這些蔬菜是用有機方式種植的，沒有噴灑化學藥劑。
The company grew organically rather than through buying others.
這家公司是自然成長，而不是靠併購其他公司。
Ideas developed organically as the team talked.
點子隨著團隊討論自然地發展出來。

balliol.zh: 貝利奧爾學院（牛津大學的學院）
ai: Balliol is one of the oldest colleges at Oxford University.
貝利奧爾學院是牛津大學最古老的學院之一。
He studied history at Balliol.
他在貝利奧爾學院讀歷史。
The waistband of these pants is too tight.
這條褲子的褲腰太緊了。
She tucked her shirt into the elastic waistband.
她把襯衫塞進有鬆緊帶的褲腰裡。
Baste the turkey with its juices every half hour.
每隔半小時就用烤出的肉汁淋一下火雞。
She basted the roast with butter to keep it moist.
她在烤肉上塗奶油讓它保持濕潤。
Baste the hem in place before sewing it properly.
正式縫合前，先把褲腳邊粗縫固定。
The engine was running at three thousand rpm.
引擎正以每分鐘三千轉運轉。
The fan spins at a low rpm to stay quiet.
風扇以低轉速運轉以保持安靜。
The sheik welcomed the guests into his tent.
酋長歡迎客人進入他的帳篷。
Each tribe was led by a sheik.
每個部落都由一位酋長領導。
Each litigant has the right to be heard by the judge.
每位訴訟當事人都有權讓法官聽取其陳述。
The litigant hired a lawyer to handle the case.
這位訴訟當事人請了律師處理案件。

snowdonia.zh: 斯諾登尼亞（威爾斯北部的山區國家公園）
ai: Snowdonia is a national park in north Wales.
斯諾登尼亞是威爾斯北部的一座國家公園。
Many hikers visit Snowdonia to climb its mountains.
許多健行者前往斯諾登尼亞攀登那裡的山。
Students must complete a practicum in a local school.
學生必須在當地學校完成實習課程。
The nursing program includes a practicum at a hospital.
護理課程包含在醫院的實習。
He is a hardcore fan who has never missed a home game.
他是個鐵桿球迷，從沒錯過任何一場主場比賽。
The band has a loyal hardcore following.
這個樂團有一群死忠的支持者。
She does a hardcore workout five days a week.
她每週五天做高強度的訓練。
It's a hardcore strategy game that takes hours to learn.
這是一款硬派策略遊戲，要花好幾個小時才能學會。

courtly.zh: 彬彬有禮的；有宮廷風範的
ai: He bowed with courtly grace and kissed her hand.
他以優雅的風度鞠躬並親吻她的手。
The poem describes courtly love in medieval times.
這首詩描寫中世紀的宮廷愛情。
He was given the captaincy of the football team.
他被任命為足球隊的隊長。
Her captaincy lasted three successful seasons.
她擔任隊長的三個球季都很成功。
The corona of the sun can be seen during a total eclipse.
日全食時可以看見太陽的日冕。
A faint corona of light surrounded the streetlamp in the fog.
霧中路燈周圍有一圈淡淡的光暈。

incurable.zh: 無法治癒的；無可救藥的
ai: The doctors said the disease was incurable.
醫生說這種疾病無法治癒。
He is an incurable optimist who always sees the bright side.
他是個無可救藥的樂觀主義者，總是看到光明面。
She has an incurable love of travel.
她對旅行有著無法抑制的熱愛。
She showed an unyielding spirit during the long campaign.
在漫長的活動中，她展現了不屈的精神。
The unyielding ground was too hard to dig.
堅硬的地面硬到無法挖掘。
He remained unyielding in his demand for fair pay.
他在爭取合理薪資的要求上毫不讓步。
An awkwardness filled the room after his joke fell flat.
他的笑話沒人笑，房裡瀰漫著尷尬的氣氛。
She felt the awkwardness of meeting her old boss again.
再次遇到老上司，她感到很尷尬。
The awkwardness of his movements made him seem shy.
他動作的笨拙讓他顯得很害羞。
Don't trivialize her worries; they are real to her.
不要把她的煩惱說得微不足道，對她而言那是真實的。
The film trivializes a serious historical event.
這部電影把一個嚴肅的歷史事件拍得太輕描淡寫。
Many families subsist on less than two dollars a day.
許多家庭靠每天不到兩美元勉強維生。
The villagers subsisted mainly on rice and fish.
村民主要靠米飯和魚維生。
Some animals can subsist for weeks without water.
有些動物可以好幾週不喝水而存活。
We walked along the towpath beside the canal.
我們沿著運河邊的縴道散步。
Cyclists enjoy the quiet towpath on weekends.
週末時，騎自行車的人喜歡這條安靜的縴道。
He made a derogatory remark about her accent.
他對她的口音說了一句貶損的話。
The teacher banned derogatory names in the classroom.
老師禁止在教室裡使用侮辱性的稱呼。
The old farm still had an outhouse behind the barn.
那座老農場在穀倉後面仍有一間戶外廁所。
They kept tools in the outhouse next to the garden.
他們把工具放在花園旁的外屋裡。
She cleaned the small cut with hydrogen peroxide.
她用雙氧水清理了那道小傷口。
Peroxide is often used to lighten hair.
雙氧水常被用來漂淡頭髮。
He came to the meeting at the behest of the director.
他應主任的要求出席了會議。
At her mother's behest, she wrote a thank-you note.
在母親的吩咐下，她寫了一張感謝卡。
He melted cheddar on top of the burger.
他把切達起司融在漢堡上。
This sharp cheddar goes well with apples.
這種味道濃郁的切達起司很適合配蘋果。
Early socialisation helps puppies get along with other dogs.
早期的社會化訓練能幫助小狗與其他狗相處。
School plays an important role in the socialisation of children.
學校在兒童的社會化過程中扮演重要角色。

marlowe.zh: 馬洛（英國伊莉莎白時代劇作家）
ai: Christopher Marlowe was an English playwright and poet.
克里斯多福．馬洛是英國劇作家兼詩人。
Marlowe lived in the same era as Shakespeare.
馬洛與莎士比亞生活在同一時代。
A good nurse is calm and empathetic.
好的護理師冷靜又有同理心。
She gave an empathetic reply to his message.
她對他的訊息做出了充滿同理心的回應。
Empathetic listeners make people feel understood.
有同理心的傾聽者會讓人覺得被理解。
They have a platonic friendship and nothing more.
他們只是純友誼的關係，沒有其他。
He kept the relationship strictly platonic.
他把這段關係維持在純粹朋友的程度。

sizzling.zh: 發出滋滋聲（sizzle 的現在分詞）
ai: The bacon was sizzling in the pan.
培根在平底鍋裡滋滋作響。
We heard the steaks sizzling on the grill.
我們聽見牛排在烤架上滋滋作響。
It was a sizzling summer afternoon.
那是一個酷熱的夏日午後。
We walked across the sizzling sand to reach the water.
我們走過滾燙的沙子來到水邊。
The company announced a lockout after talks with the union failed.
與工會談判破裂後，公司宣布關廠停工。
The lockout lasted several weeks and affected hundreds of workers.
這次停工持續了數週，影響了數百名工人。
A broken cog stopped the old clock from running.
一個壞掉的輪齒讓老時鐘停了下來。
Each cog in the machine turns the next one.
機器裡的每個齒輪都帶動下一個。
He felt like a small cog in a huge company.
他覺得自己只是一家大公司裡的小齒輪。
Hot weather can quickly dehydrate you if you don't drink water.
天氣炎熱時，如果不喝水，很快就會脫水。
They dehydrate fruit to make healthy snacks.
他們把水果脫水做成健康的零食。
In the past, women often wore a corset under their dresses.
過去女性常在洋裝裡面穿緊身胸衣。
The museum displays a corset from the nineteenth century.
博物館展出一件十九世紀的緊身胸衣。

aerodynamic.zh: 空氣動力學的；流線型的
ai: The car has an aerodynamic shape that reduces wind drag.
這輛車有降低風阻的流線型外形。
Engineers tested the aerodynamic design in a wind tunnel.
工程師在風洞裡測試了這個空氣動力學設計。
A medieval serf worked the land of a lord.
中世紀的農奴為領主耕種土地。
Serfs were not free to leave the estate where they lived.
農奴不能自由離開自己居住的莊園。

jekyll.zh: 傑基爾醫生（小說《化身博士》中的人物）
ai: Dr. Jekyll is a character in a novel by Robert Louis Stevenson.
傑基爾醫生是史蒂文森小說中的人物。
People sometimes say someone has a Jekyll and Hyde personality.
人們有時會說某人有「傑基爾與海德」式的雙重人格。

rinsed.zh: 沖洗；漂洗（rinse 的過去式）
ai: She rinsed the dishes under cold water.
她用冷水沖洗碗盤。
He rinsed the soap out of his hair.
他把頭髮上的肥皂沖乾淨。
We rinsed the sand off our feet before getting in the car.
上車前我們把腳上的沙沖掉。
We sat by the rippling water of the pond.
我們坐在泛著漣漪的池塘邊。
The rippling muscles in his arms showed his strength.
他手臂上起伏的肌肉顯示出他的力量。
A rippling laugh came from the next room.
隔壁房間傳來一陣清脆起伏的笑聲。
The town built a statue to memorialize the fallen soldiers.
鎮上立了一座雕像來紀念陣亡的士兵。
They planted a tree to memorialize their teacher.
他們種了一棵樹來紀念他們的老師。
The poem exalts the beauty of nature.
這首詩讚頌大自然的美。
The speech exalted the hard work of the volunteers.
這場演說高度讚揚志工的辛勤付出。
Success should not exalt you above your friends.
成功不該讓你覺得自己高人一等。
He was appointed to the bishopric in 1850.
他在一八五〇年被任命為主教。
The bishopric covered several towns and villages.
這個主教轄區涵蓋好幾個城鎮和村莊。
Aquaculture supplies a large share of the fish we eat.
水產養殖提供了我們所吃的魚的一大部分。
The coastal village makes a living from shrimp aquaculture.
這個沿海村莊靠養殖蝦子維生。
"Great job," he said sarcastically after she dropped the tray.
她打翻托盤後，他諷刺地說：「幹得好。」
She smiled sarcastically and walked away.
她譏諷地笑了笑就走開了。
He sarcastically thanked them for arriving two hours late.
他挖苦地感謝他們遲到了兩個小時。
He is a snob who only talks to rich people.
他是個勢利眼，只跟有錢人說話。
Don't be a snob about the food just because it's cheap.
別因為食物便宜就擺出一副看不起的樣子。
The town was damaged by an airstrike last year.
這個城鎮去年在一次空襲中受損。
The government warned of a possible airstrike.
政府警告可能發生空襲。
The thief and his confederate were caught outside the shop.
小偷和他的同夥在店外被抓住了。
She trusted him as a loyal confederate in the project.
她把他當作計畫中忠實的盟友。
The confederate states agreed to share a common defense.
這些結盟的邦同意共同防衛。
They formed a confederate group of small companies.
他們組成了一個由小公司聯合起來的團體。
She prefers indie films to big studio movies.
她比較喜歡獨立製作的電影，而不是大片廠的電影。
He plays in an indie band that records at home.
他在一個在家錄音的獨立樂團裡演奏。
The indie game was made by two friends.
這款獨立遊戲是由兩位朋友製作的。
Calling the wind "angry" is an example of personification.
說風「很生氣」就是擬人法的例子。
The poem uses personification to give the sea a voice.
這首詩用擬人手法讓大海有了聲音。
He is the personification of kindness.
他是仁慈的化身。
The restaurant was full of celebs last night.
昨晚這家餐廳擠滿了名人。
She follows several celebs on social media.
她在社群媒體上追蹤好幾位名人。
A weasel slipped through the gap in the fence.
一隻鼬鼠從籬笆縫隙鑽了過去。
The weasel is small, quick, and has a long thin body.
鼬鼠體型小、動作快，身體細長。
He's a weasel who never keeps his promises.
他是個狡猾的人，從不遵守承諾。
Don't trust that weasel with your money.
別把錢交給那個奸詐的傢伙。
The futurist predicted how cities might look in fifty years.
這位未來學家預測五十年後城市可能的樣貌。
A famous futurist spoke at the technology conference.
一位著名的未來學家在科技研討會上發表演說。
The setter placed each stone carefully in the wall.
砌石工人小心地把每塊石頭嵌入牆裡。
In volleyball, the setter passes the ball to the hitter.
在排球中，舉球員會把球傳給攻擊手。
Our neighbor has a red setter that loves to run.
我們鄰居養了一隻愛跑步的紅色塞特犬。
The setter found the bird hiding in the grass.
塞特犬找到了藏在草叢裡的鳥。
The choir stood in the chancel near the altar.
詩班站在靠近祭壇的內殿裡。
A carved wooden screen separates the chancel from the rest of the church.
一道雕花木屏把內殿和教堂其他部分隔開。
They used a winch to pull the boat onto the trailer.
他們用絞車把船拉上拖車。
The truck has a winch on the front for emergencies.
這輛卡車前面裝有絞盤以備緊急使用。
The crew winched the car out of the mud.
工作人員用絞車把車從泥巴裡拉出來。
They winched the heavy box up to the roof.
他們用絞盤把沉重的箱子吊到屋頂。
The children laughed as the carousel went around.
旋轉木馬轉動時孩子們開心地笑著。
She chose a white horse on the carousel.
她在旋轉木馬上挑了一匹白馬。
We waited at the carousel for our suitcases.
我們在行李轉盤旁等著領行李。
My bag was the last to come out on the carousel.
我的行李是最後一個從轉盤上出來的。
My uncle has been a Tory all his life.
我叔叔一輩子都是保守黨員。
The Tory candidate spoke at the town hall.
保守黨候選人在市政廳發表了演說。

vulcan.zh: 伏爾甘（羅馬神話中的火神與鍛造之神）
ai: In Roman myth, Vulcan was the god of fire and metalworking.
在羅馬神話中，伏爾甘是火與金屬工藝之神。
The statue shows Vulcan working at his forge.
這座雕像呈現伏爾甘在爐前工作的樣子。
The loud song of the cicada filled the summer air.
蟬的響亮鳴聲充滿了夏日的空氣。
We found an empty cicada shell on the tree.
我們在樹上發現一個空的蟬殼。
A hyena is known for its laughing-like call.
鬣狗以像笑聲一樣的叫聲聞名。
The hyena waited near the lions for leftover food.
鬣狗在獅子附近等著吃剩下的食物。

rallying.zh: 集結；重新振作（rally 的現在分詞）
ai: Supporters were rallying outside the town hall.
支持者正聚集在市政廳外。
The team is rallying after a poor start.
球隊在糟糕的開局後正在重振旗鼓。
Prices are rallying after last week's sharp fall.
價格在上週大跌之後正在回升。
Caviar comes from the eggs of the sturgeon.
魚子醬來自鱘魚的卵。
A huge sturgeon was caught in the river.
河裡捕到了一條巨大的鱘魚。
She starts chemo next week and is feeling hopeful.
她下週開始化療，心情抱持希望。
The chemo made him tired, but he kept working.
化療讓他很疲倦，但他仍繼續工作。
The artist left the painting untitled.
藝術家沒有為這幅畫命名。
I found an untitled document on my desktop.
我在桌面上發現一份沒有標題的文件。
A samurai was a warrior in feudal Japan.
武士是封建時代日本的戰士。
The museum has armor once worn by a samurai.
博物館收藏了一套武士曾穿過的盔甲。
Haiti is a country in the Caribbean.
海地是加勒比海的一個國家。
Port-au-Prince is the capital of Haiti.
太子港是海地的首都。

untenable.zh: 站不住腳的；難以維持的
ai: His argument was untenable once the facts came out.
事實揭露後，他的論點就站不住腳了。
The company's position became untenable after the loss.
虧損之後，公司的處境變得難以為繼。
It is untenable to claim that nothing needs to change.
聲稱什麼都不需要改變是說不通的。
He showed up in a rumpled shirt after the long flight.
長途飛行後，他穿著皺巴巴的襯衫現身。
She smoothed the rumpled sheets on the bed.
她撫平床上皺亂的床單。

rumpled.zh: 弄皺；弄亂（rumple 的過去式）
ai: The wind rumpled her hair as she walked along the beach.
她走在海灘上時，風把她的頭髮吹亂了。
He rumpled the paper in his fist and threw it away.
他把紙握成一團然後丟掉。
A snail is a kind of mollusc.
蝸牛是軟體動物的一種。
Oysters and clams are molluscs that live in shells.
牡蠣和蛤蜊是住在殼裡的軟體動物。
The patient was given general anaesthesia before the operation.
病人在手術前接受了全身麻醉。
Local anaesthesia numbs only a small part of the body.
局部麻醉只會讓身體的一小部分失去知覺。
Her grandparents performed in vaudeville in the 1920s.
她的祖父母在一九二〇年代的雜耍歌舞團表演過。
The theater once hosted vaudeville acts every weekend.
這間劇院過去每個週末都有雜耍歌舞表演。
Blimey, that's a huge cake!
天啊，這蛋糕好大！
"Blimey, is that the time already?" he said.
「哎呀，已經這麼晚了嗎？」他說。
A grapevine grows along the wall of their garden.
他們花園的牆邊爬著一株葡萄藤。
The grapevine needs to be trimmed every winter.
葡萄藤每年冬天都需要修剪。
I heard through the grapevine that she's moving abroad.
我從小道消息聽說她要搬到國外。
News travels fast on the office grapevine.
消息在辦公室的小道傳聞中傳得很快。
A tern dived into the sea to catch a small fish.
一隻燕鷗俯衝入海抓了一條小魚。
Terns fly thousands of miles every year.
燕鷗每年飛行數千英里。
She shared her innermost thoughts with her best friend.
她對最要好的朋友說出了內心最深處的想法。
The innermost room of the temple was closed to visitors.
神殿最深處的房間不對遊客開放。
He has a smattering of French from a short trip.
他因為一次短期旅行而略懂一點法文。
A smattering of applause came from the audience.
觀眾席傳來零星的掌聲。
All the computers in the office are networked.
辦公室裡所有電腦都連上了網路。
A networked printer lets everyone share one machine.
連網的印表機讓大家共用一台機器。

falkirk.zh: 福爾柯克（蘇格蘭中部城鎮）
ai: Falkirk is a town in central Scotland.
福爾柯克是蘇格蘭中部的一座城鎮。
The Falkirk Wheel is a rotating boat lift near the town.
福爾柯克轉輪是該鎮附近的旋轉式船隻升降機。
Smoke inhalation is dangerous during a fire.
火災時吸入濃煙十分危險。
Take a deep inhalation and then breathe out slowly.
深深吸一口氣，然後慢慢吐氣。
The draper sold cloth and curtains in the old market.
這位布商在老市場販賣布料和窗簾。
Her grandfather worked as a draper for forty years.
她的祖父當了四十年的布商。
He keeps a hammer and screwdrivers in the toolbox.
他把鐵鎚和螺絲起子放在工具箱裡。
Please put the toolbox back in the garage.
請把工具箱放回車庫。
The weather in the mountains is capricious.
山區的天氣變化無常。
The capricious king changed his mind every day.
那位反覆無常的國王每天都改變主意。
She has a capricious taste in music.
她對音樂的喜好多變難測。
The accident left him paralyzed from the waist down.
那場意外讓他腰部以下癱瘓。
She stood paralyzed with fear when the dog barked.
狗吠叫時，她嚇得僵在原地。
He sat in the corner and glowered at everyone.
他坐在角落，怒視著所有人。
The boy glowered at his sister when she took his toy.
妹妹拿走他的玩具時，男孩對她怒目而視。
It is rude to disparage another person's work.
貶低別人的工作成果是很沒禮貌的。
She never disparages her rivals in public.
她從不在公開場合貶低她的對手。
The sameness of the daily routine made him bored.
日復一日千篇一律的生活讓他感到無聊。
Critics complained about the sameness of the movie's plot.
評論家抱怨這部電影的劇情千篇一律。
The boxer was hit in the midsection and fell to his knees.
拳擊手腹部中拳而跪倒在地。
The midsection of the bridge was closed for repairs.
橋的中段因維修而封閉。

induced.zh: 引起；誘發（induce 的過去式）
ai: The medicine induced a deep sleep.
這藥物讓人進入深度睡眠。
Nothing could have induced him to sell the house.
什麼都無法說服他賣掉那棟房子。
The doctor decided on an induced labor for safety.
為了安全起見，醫生決定採用引產。
Stress-induced headaches are common among students.
壓力引起的頭痛在學生之間很常見。
The city was a hotbed of new ideas and art.
這座城市是新思想與藝術的溫床。
Crowded places can be a hotbed for germs.
擁擠的地方可能成為細菌的溫床。
She acted as a peacemaker between the two angry friends.
她在兩位生氣的朋友之間扮演和事佬。
A good peacemaker listens to both sides.
好的調停者會傾聽雙方的意見。
The ad has a snappy slogan that is easy to remember.
這則廣告的標語簡潔有力，容易記住。
Make it snappy, or we'll miss the bus.
動作快點，不然我們會錯過公車。
He wore a snappy new suit to the interview.
他穿著一套時髦的新西裝去面試。
She always looks snappy in that red jacket.
她穿那件紅外套總是看起來很俐落時髦。
Everyone knew him by the moniker "Big Tom."
大家都叫他「大湯姆」這個綽號。
The band chose a funny moniker for its first album.
這個樂團為第一張專輯取了個有趣的名字。
Don't be so melodramatic; it's only a small scratch.
別那麼誇張，只是個小擦傷而已。
The film's melodramatic ending made some viewers laugh.
這部電影煽情誇張的結局讓一些觀眾笑了出來。
